original: Hi, how can I help you?
I saw these boots on your site that look so cool. I really want them
When I saw them yesterday, they were really cheap. But now they are much more expensive
Why are the boots more expensive now?
I understand. That can be very frustrating
Let me pull up your account and we can discuss it
Can I have your full name or Account ID please?
(Although I don't feel very joyous today)
Account has been pulled up for Joyce Wu.
A reason of yesterday has been recorded.
Joy, can I have your Account ID and Order ID please?
Our prices are often changed automatically using an algorithm
It takes current market price and competitor prices into account when making changes
But I am a Gold member! That's not fair to make me pay a higher price. Can you honor the price from yesterday?
Unfortunately, I can't do anything about the pricing changes. I do understand your frustration and we value our Gold members!
I want to speak to a manager
What I can do is create a Promo code for you now
Well that would be good too :)
Yes, It will give you a discount equal to what you spent!
We value you as a customer
Oh, I am happy with that fix
Great! We want you to leave happy at the end of the day!
Let me create the Promo code for you now
A promo code has been created.
Ok, here is your Promo code:
Use it at check out next time you shop with us
Thank you! It means a lot to me that you are willing to fix this
Your welcome! Glad to help a loyal customer
Can I do anything else for you today?
Ok, have a great day Joy
